How To Hire Data Scientists at Mobilunity

Determine Your Needs

Define your project requirements and necessary data science expertise. Determine what niches your ideal candidate should be skilled at, whether ML, computer vision, or NLP.

{02}

Contact Us

Get in touch with Mobilunity by filling out the form below. We’ll handle job market research and check our available talent pool based on your needs, estimated budget, and business goals.

{03}

{04}

{Services}

Services Offered By Our Data Scientists

Data Collection

Get data engineering specialists to collect raw data based on your requirements. Our experts gather structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources for reliable insights.

Data Preparation

Reduce unstructured data using our expertise in data cleaning and data wrangling. Leverage techniques like feature engineering and data normalization to ensure it is suitable for further analysis.

Data Modeling

Organize your datasets with specialists from Mobilunity. Structure your database and build predictive and statistical data models for diverse uses, from finding trends to deriving insights from data.

Data Warehousing

Store your datasets in one location, readily available for analysis and reporting. Let our data scientists design and implement a data warehouse that centralizes all your information.

Data Visualization

Make sense of complex data with Mobilunity’s specialists. Our experts simplify the data you need using cutting-edge data visualization tools, allowing you to digest the info in a visually appealing format.

Data Pipelines

Enable quick, on-the-spot data analysis through data pipelines. Improve business analytics and manage data with a researcher who can collect, organize, and structure info from various sources.

Algorithm Selection

Our experts are ready to help you select a machine learning algorithm tailored to your needs. Hire a data scientist proficient in exploratory data analysis, experimentation, hypothesis testing, and other methods.

Model Training and Validation

Leverage supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning to train your models. Hire a data scientist with us to get robust validation procedures like confusion matrices, cross-validation, and ROC curves.

Model Development and Deployment

Build and deploy custom ML models leveraging our specialists’ experience in data science and engineering. Adjust them to handle classification, clustering, natural language processing, and other tasks.

Model Evaluation

Analyze your model’s performance by entrusting data science recruiting to Mobilunity. We will help you employ recall, precision, accuracy, F1 score, and other metrics to identify and tackle any issues.

Big Data and Data Science Consulting

Collaborate with data scientists from Mobilunity to check your existing data architecture. Find strategies for improvements, choose best tools for architecture management, and get the most out of your datasets.

Statistical Modeling

Test your hypotheses and validate your assumptions with statistical models built by our experts. Study your historical data to measure the likelihood of future events.

{methods}

Methods Used by Our Data Scientists

ML Algorithms

Our data scientists prepare data for training and use decision trees, random forests, linear and logistic regression, support vector machines, and KNN to create machine learning models.

Deep Learning

Mobilunity’s data scientists utilize neural networks, CNNs, RNNs, and other deep learning techniques. You can be sure our profound expertise helps you find relevant patterns and data insights.

Supervised Learning

Select and curate labeled data to train your AI models. Get access to Mobilunity’s data scientists for professional guidance in model architecture, parameter selection, and algorithm suitability.

Unsupervised Learning

Find patterns and relationships within your unlabeled data through our data scientist recruiting. Allow our specialists to extract insights from your datasets using unsupervised ML algorithms.

Transfer Learning

Hire a data analyst with Mobilunity to leverage transfer learning solutions. Select and customize pre-trained models like BERT, Xception, and more to train your models faster and more efficiently.

Reinforcement Learning

Get our professionals to leverage reinforcement learning techniques, including the Markov decision process, tune your models for maximum performance and better decision-making.

NLP

Work with our expert data scientists to get insights from text data. Employ various NLP toolkits along with sentiment analysis, entity recognition, language generation, and even more techniques.

Computer Vision

Analyze your images, videos, 3D models, and other visual data with Mobilunity’s skilled data scientists on board. Teach your model to classify and detect objects with our professional help.

FAQs

Do you offer assistance with data scientist technical interviews?

Certainly, we provide support for data scientist technical interviews for an extra fee. We ensure these interviews are conducted by top experts in the field and cover software development, data science, and other related topics. After the interview, you get a comprehensive report with insights from the interviewer.. 

What are the advantages of cooperation with Mobilunity’s data scientists?

When you recruit data science developers from Mobilunity, you access in-depth expertise in data science concepts, which include data collection, data manipulation, data exploration, and beyond. You also benefit from hassle-free team management as we handle all administrative tasks.

What businesses can benefit from hiring data scientists at Mobilunity?

Any company that requires data to solve issues, make more informed decisions, or streamline operations can gain advantages from Mobilunity’s data scientists’ work. From finance and healthcare to e-commerce and beyond, we offer custom solutions, regardless of the industry.

Why should I hire data scientists with Mobilunity?

Mobilunity offers flexible collaboration models that allow you to quickly find the right expert with skills in AI, ML, and Big Data. We handle all administrative tasks so you can focus on growing your business.

How quickly can I hire a data scientist through Mobilunity?

The recruitment process typically takes 1 to 3 weeks, depending on your specific requirements. We conduct pre-screening, interviews, and skill assessments before introducing candidates to you.

What is the difference between a data scientist and a data analyst?

Data Scientists focus on machine learning, predictive modeling, AI, and handling large datasets.
Data Analysts specialize in data visualization, reporting, and business analytics.

Can I hire a data scientist for a short-term project?

Yes, our FLEX model (Part-Time Data Science Developers) allows you to hire an expert for specific tasks or short-term projects.

How do I get started with Mobilunity?

Fill out a request on our website, and our team will contact you to discuss your project details and find the perfect candidate for your needs.
